positive.source: script Minimal version "1.0.0"; entity E { on start { return; } }
module game.math version "1.0.0"; import base.types; export record Point { x: Rat; y: Rat; } export fn twice(x: Int) -> Int = x * 2;
module world.api version "1.0.0"; export capability world.temperature(Vec2) -> Rat observation; export capability audio.play(Text) -> Unit effect;

script Records version "1.0.0"; record Damage { amount: Int; critical: Bool; } entity E { state d: Damage = Damage(amount = 12, critical = false); on start { let x = Damage(amount = 1, critical = true); return; } }
script Enums version "1.0.0"; enum Kind { A; B; C; } entity E { state k: Kind = Kind::A; on start { match k { Kind::A => { log "a"; } Kind::B => { log "b"; } Kind::C => { log "c"; } } } }

script Sums version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Option<Int> = Some(1); state y: Result<Int, Text> = Ok(2); on start { match x { Some(v) => { log "some"; } None => { log "none"; } } match y { Ok(v) => { log "ok"; } Err(e) => { log e; } } } }
script Loop version "1.0.0"; entity E { on start { for i in -2 .. 3 { log "tick"; } } }

script Beh version "1.0.0"; behavior Base { state alive: Bool = true; on start { log "base"; } } behavior Move { use Base; state speed: Rat = 1.0; on update { move vec2(speed, 0); } } entity E { use Move; on update { animate "Walk"; } }
script Types version "1.0.0"; record Box { value: Result<Option<Int>, Text>; } entity E { state box: Box = Box(value = Ok(Some(1))); on start { return; } }
script Scope version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Int = 0; on update { if true { let y: Int = 1; x = y; } else { let z = 2; x = z; } } }
script Field version "1.0.0"; record Pair { x: Int; y: Int; } entity E { state x: Int = 0; on start { let v = (Pair(x = 1, y = 2)).x; return; } }
script Expr version "1.0.0"; entity E { state out: Bool = false; on update { out = 1 + 2 * 3 < 8 and not false or true; } }
